formula_definition: Ideal Viral Score (Normalized): VS = w1*(likes/reach) + w2*(shares/reach)*2.5 + w3*(saves/reach)*2.0 + w4*(comments/reach)*1.5 + w5*(velocity_decay)
proxy_alternative: Content Virality Propensity Proxy (CVPP): Combines hashtag intensity, mention resonance, emoji richness, and sentiment polarity as structural content proxies.
data_limitation_notice: Native Instagram interaction counts (likes, comments, shares, saves, impressions) are NOT present in the current review dataset. Viral Score cannot be fully computed without genuine post-level engagement telemetry.
